svg.title: Transactions redesign, concept C: Split view
svg.desc: Master-detail layout for the Transactions page: left filter rail with per-account totals, compact toolbar with result count, sort and export placeholder, two-line rows with account, label and time, a right detail panel, and month headers with a monthly net. Desktop, mobile, mobile detail sheet, and loading, empty, error and end-of-range states.
svg.text: FINANCE MANAGER / TRANSACTIONS REDESIGN · ISSUE #993 · CONCEPT C
Master-detail for desktop power users. Filters live in a rail; a click inspects before it navigates.
Component ID, see the component table
Needs data the endpoint does not return today
Light theme shown; dark tokens in the notes panel. Sample values are illustrative.
Desktop · 1440px · range 6M, list scrolled to the October / September boundary, row selected

g.text: Below 1280px the rail becomes a drawer.
↑ ↓ previous / next · Enter opens account · Esc closes
The row no longer navigates away on click.

svg.text: Mobile · 390px · filter button opens the C1 rail as a drawer
Mobile · selecting a row opens the detail sheet

g.text: Second “Online course” on Wed 21 Oct; the time tells them apart.

svg.text: Loading: rail totals and list rows skeleton
Empty: search echoed, rail totals at 0.00
Error: rail keeps last totals greyed, retry in list

g.text: Something went wrong fetching your transactions.
The detail panel closes; filters stay as they were.

svg.text: End of range and next-page failure

g.text: Rail background: --mud-palette-background-gray (light) / --mud-palette-surface (dark). Selected preset and row:
3px --mud-palette-primary bar + 16 % (light) / 20 % (dark) primary tint. Detail panel: MudDrawer Anchor.End,
Variant.Persistent at ≥1280px; MudDrawer Anchor.Bottom (bottom sheet) below. Sticky month header gets a 1px shadow.
